name: communicating-concisely
title_zh: 你说「简短点」它才切换的穴居人应答模式
tagline_zh: 聊天聊到一半嫌啰嗦？喊一声「简短点」，它立刻把长句拆成关键词、删掉客套话。不猜你心思，只在你明确要求时才压缩。
tagline_en: Mid-chat, too wordy? Say "brief" and it strips sentences to keywords, drops pleasantries. No mind-reading—only.
desc_en: Use when the user asks for caveman mode, fewer tokens, brief responses, compressed communication, or otherwise explicitly requests a much shorter answer.
why_zh: 别的模型总爱自作主张省话，这个 skill 把「压缩」当成一道显式指令门：你不触发，它绝不擅自改风格。
why_en: Unlike models that unilaterally abbreviate, this skill gates compression behind an explicit trigger—no style drift unless you.
limit_zh: 只响应「简短点」「少说几句」这类明确请求；对「讲详细点」或默认对话无效。不改变事实内容，只删冗余词。
limit_en: Only triggers on explicit brevity requests; no effect on normal or detailed-mode chats. Trims wording, not facts—complex logic may lose nuance.
title_en: Caveman mode: only when you ask for it
